correctness.rationale: Every automorphism is reconstructed directly as a pair consisting of an invertible two-dimensional quotient action and an arbitrary central covector, with the center scaled by the determinant. The fixed-point equations reduce to a two-dimensional kernel and one scalar equation. A complete five-stratum count of the quotient matrix gives all multiplicities, including characteristic two. The formulas sum to the full automorphism-group order and their Burnside weighted sum is exactly three. Exhaustive checks over q=2,3,4,5,7, including the extension field F_4, reproduce every fiber exactly.

value.rationale: The fixed-set-size distribution is a natural refinement of the already-studied fixed-point-free count: it determines every theta-value for automorphisms of this finite Lie algebra, not just the regular fiber. The result is uniform over every finite field, exposes the exceptional disappearance of fixed-point-free automorphisms at q=2, and has an intrinsic Burnside check yielding exactly three element-orbits. This is a complete structural finite-field invariant rather than an arbitrary small-parameter census.
